title: Chapter 604 - 604 Choice; Skill Replication!
content:
Chapter 604 - 604 Choice; Skill Replication!

Chapter 604 - 604 Choice; Skill Replication!

604 Choice; Skill Replication!

“It’s my turn!” Abraham shouted and jumped up to punch the golden bear.

However, the giant golden bear seemed to have expected this. Before Abraham’s fist could hit him, it slapped him with its claws again.

Abraham’s pupils constricted. He forcefully twisted his body in the air to avoid being sent flying by the giant golden bear.

Even so, the giant golden bear’s sharp claws left a few scarlet scratch marks on Abraham’s back.

Blood slowly fell to the ground.

Abraham panted heavily. “That’s impressive. I can’t fall behind!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he punched the giant golden bear.

A few more bones of the giant golden bear broke.

Then, the giant golden bear waved its claws again.

Abraham hurriedly dodged, but a few more scratches appeared on his body.

Just like that, the two of them attacked each other.

It could be said that every punch hit the flesh. It was very tough.

In the end, Abraham punched the golden bear’s head.

The skull was broken, and the giant golden bear fell to the ground, quickly losing all its vitality.

At this moment, Abraham’s entire body was covered in no less than 20 scratch marks. His entire body seemed to be soaked in blood, and he looked extremely miserable.

However, Abraham’s face was full of smiles.

He had won.

Then, an emotionless voice sounded in his ears.

[The first to kill a level-four Golden Bear. You’ve obtained a level-four treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-four Golden Bear. The lifespan of Bear Country citizens has increased by one year.]

Then, an ancient chest appeared in front of him.

Abraham had already opened such chests before and knew that there was something good inside them.

Therefore, he did not hesitate to open it.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Sound Wave Technique. Do you want to use it?]

“Of course, I do!” Abraham said.

The ball of light in the box instantly entered his body.

Abraham’s throat moved, and a strange power surged up and down his mind.

Before he could try it out, he heard brisk footsteps not far away.

A tall and handsome man, a dog, and a brown-skinned man slowly appeared in his field of vision.

It was Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam.

Sam hurriedly stood in front of Lin Fan and said in English, “Who are you?”

Not long ago, he had already experienced being threatened by Hashimoto Musashi. He was on guard with all new people.

Moreover, Abraham was covered in blood, which made him look dangerous. Naturally, he had to be more careful.

When Abraham saw Lin Fan and Sam, he was not as wary.

He seemed very happy and said in English, “I’m Abraham from Bear Country! I finally met the people from Earth. Who are you?”

“I’m Sam from Bai Country,” Sam said.

“I’m Lin Fan from Hua Nation,” Lin Fan said.

Lin Fan’s impression of Bear Country was not bad.

In addition, Abraham did not show any hostility.

Hence, Lin Fan’s tone of introduction was rather polite.

Abraham became even happier.

“So it’s Bai Country and Hua Nation!”

“I often buy things in Hua Nation. They’re very practical and beautiful!”

After a few words, their relationship became much closer.

Lin Fan said, “You seem to have a lot of injuries. Do you need treatment?”

“They’re just small injuries.” Abraham waved his hand. “They’ll heal very quickly.”

In fact, that was exactly the case.

That was because he had 400 Constitution points.

Not only did they increase his strength, but they also increased his speed and recovery ability.

Lin Fan nodded his head.

“We’re all Earthlings,” Abraham said. “We should be traveling together in the Otherworld. It’ll be safer if we can take care of each other.

“However, I feel that we should face danger alone in the Otherworld. Only then can we continue to grow.

“So, I won’t be with you guys anymore.

“In fact, I think it’s best for the two of you to leave separately.”

“I want to be with Master all the time,” Sam said immediately.

Abraham nodded thoughtfully and said, “Teacher and student?”

He felt his wounds gradually scab over and said, “It’s about time. I’ll be leaving first. Lin Fan, Sam, goodbye.”

Abraham waved his hand and strode forward.

Lin Fan and Sam said, “Goodbye.””

This scene appeared in Bear Country’s live broadcast room.

Abraham had killed a level-four Golden Bear and obtained Beginner Sound Wave Technique.

At the same time, the lifespan of the citizens of Bear Country also increased by one year.

This was undoubtedly… something that made the people of Bear Country very happy.

However, at this moment, in Bear Country’s live broadcast room, the comments were full of accusations against Abraham.

Mavis: [Heavens! Abraham actually rejected Lin Fan!]

Basil Bo: [What a great opportunity!]

Bunian: [Alone? Grow? God, Abraham, do you know what you’ve lost?]

Dean: [One year of lifespan? What’s the use of one year of lifespan? Why didn’t you follow Lin Fan?]

Armand: [He’s gone, and he’s walking so fast.]

Bodley: [Lin Fan even asked him if he needed treatment. Lin Fan… Even that Heavenly Hound could heal Abraham very quickly, and he still said they were just small injuries.]

Adolf: [That’s right. Even if you want to leave, you should at least let Lin Fan treat you before you leave.]

Nanni: [He’ll never know how wrong his choice was.]

…

Naturally, Lin Fan did not know the reaction of the people from Bear Country.

Since Abraham did not want to follow him, Lin Fan did not want to force him to stay.

He looked at Abraham’s back and chose another direction.

Not long after Lin Fan left, a crisp notification sounded out in his mind.

[Ding! You’ve walked 1,000,000 steps in the Otherworld. You’ve obtained Skill Replication.]

Replication?

Lin Fan was curious and focused his attention.

[Skill Replication: Able to copy the abilities of others at will. You can easily learn other people’s abilities and even obtain stronger abilities, thus displaying your unique charm.]

Seeing this, Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

If he had obtained Skill Replication before the appearance of the Otherworld, Lin Fan would not have felt that it would be of much use.

After all, his driving, mathematics, physics, chemistry, and other skills were far superior to ordinary people.

However, after the appearance of the Otherworld, such a skill had its uses.

This was because after killing a ferocious beast in the Otherworld, one could open a treasure chest and obtain power or different abilities.

Not long ago, after surviving for 30 days, everyone opened a treasure chest and obtained abilities.

Lin Fan should be able to find abilities worth replicating.

Then, Lin Fan turned his body and looked at Sam.

He had an ability… Beginner Gigantization Technique.

[Skill Replication: Beginner Gigantization Technique!]
